content:
Apple TV is getting ready for the holidays early, announcing today two brand new holiday specials coming soon, along with free viewing offers for several beloved Peanuts classics. Here's the rundown.

New Peanuts and Muppets holiday specials, a family movie starring Chris Pratt, and more coming to Apple TV

This year, Apple is launching two brand new holiday specials from two beloved classic franchises:

  • "Snoopy Presents: A Snoopy Pie Christmas" (working title) premieres Friday, November 13
  • "The Muppets: A Holiday Gift" (working title) follows on Friday, December 4

Each new special will join Apple TV's existing library of Peanuts and Muppets content.

In the press release announcing the specials, Apple TV also highlighted the family-friendly new film Way of the Warrior Kid. The film will debut on Wednesday, November 25, starring Chris Pratt and Linda Cardellini. While the movie isn't holiday-themed, Apple enjoys premiering a new family film around Thanksgiving each year. Here's a synopsis:

In addition to this year's new additions, Apple will also make several beloved Peanuts holiday specials available to watch for free to the public on select weekends later this year. The dates are as follows:

  • It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown: October 17–18
  • A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving: November 14–15
  • A Charlie Brown Christmas: December 12–13

Apple TV subscribers can stream the specials anytime, all year long. But on those dates, anyone can watch for free.

Other holiday viewing recommendations from me personally include Apple's musical comedy Spirited, starring Ryan Reynolds and Will Ferrell, and the must-watch-for-Ted-Lasso-fans Hannah Waddingham: Home for Christmas.

What's your favorite Apple TV holiday special? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, and you can also get it at a discount through an Apple One bundle.
